conflict_flags.rationale: The BOD footprint dimensions (77'-4" × 83'-8" ≈ 6,471 SF) represent the three-bay Option 1 building. The Pre-35% Purpose document confirms a two-bay alternative (Option 2) exists and the cost estimate at 95% design explicitly calls out a '2-bay vehicle wash building (approx. 3,860 SF)'. The 95% cost estimate reflects the design as actually advanced and is the more authoritative source for the built scope.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Both recorded; X33677 likely Boeing procurement number, 08-2023 the Boeing SOW document reference number
